independent_references.free_fall: analytic constant-gravity trajectory before floor contact
independent_references.expected_difference: semi-implicit position integration differs from continuous free fall by at most one fixed-step velocity increment

collision_model: configured geometry terminates the run; no contact impulse or crash deformation is resolved

multi_vehicle_model: independent vehicle dynamics and identity-scoped faults; no aerodynamic interaction
